description: Creates the one Stripe Checkout link that pays for a domain registration and saves the card of the customer, so every later purchase can happen inside this conversation. This is the only time the user leaves the chat - give them the returned URL. Reach for this only after they have asked to publish. A refused or unchecked domain ending carries `reason` and a plain `reason_text`: unsupported or price_unavailable mean we do not sell that ending right now; lookup_failed or cap_reached mean it was NOT checked, so search again, and never tell the customer we do not sell it.

domain.description: The full domain to buy, e.g. example.com.

title: Create payment link
